author: Microsoft
name: TRELLIS.2 4B
summary: The quality pick: a full textured PBR mesh from one image. Runs locally on Metal through the trellis-mac port. First run downloads about 13 GB of weights.

author: Tencent
installDetail: Ready to go — runs natively on Apple Silicon.
name: Hunyuan3D 2 mini
summary: The fast pick: clean geometry in about twenty seconds, native MLX. No texture — pair it with TRELLIS.2 when you need one, or take it straight to your modelling tool.

author: Tencent
installDetail: Ready to go — runs natively on Apple Silicon.
name: Hunyuan3D 2 turbo
summary: The large shape model, distilled to finish in 8 steps — better geometry than mini at nearly the same speed, for a bigger download.

author: LoHhhha et al.
name: LATO.2 (remote)
summary: Clean, low-poly meshes with a vertex budget you choose — the output that goes straight into a game engine or CAD. CUDA-only, so it runs on your LATO.2 service machine; this Mac just sends the image and receives the mesh.

author: Stability AI + Tripo
installDetail: Not available yet — no one has made a version of this one that runs on a Mac. It's listed so you can see what's coming.
name: TripoSR
summary: A small single-shot reconstructor: rough mesh in seconds from ~1.5 GB of weights. Lower fidelity than everything above — worth having for silhouette drafts once a runner is wired up.

author: Stability AI
installDetail: Not available yet — no one has made a version of this one that runs on a Mac. It's listed so you can see what's coming.
name: Stable Fast 3D
summary: UV-unwrapped, textured meshes in under a second on datacenter GPUs; on Apple Silicon it needs a port that does not exist yet. Catalogued for the roadmap.
